ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher under NS-7; no account action against the driver.
ruling.reasoning:
This is a rider-side cancellation: cancelled_by = rider, so the fee can only stand through NS-0's rider branch, which sends an on-demand booking to NS-4 [F2][NS-0]. NS-4 makes a cancellation within 3:00 of matching non-chargeable, and after 3:00 chargeable [F2][NS-4]. The timeline is settled: acceptance 14:05:00, rider cancellation 14:07:55, i.e. 2 min 55 s = 175 s, inside the 3-minute window [F2][NS-4]. The $6.61 on record therefore has no basis and is refundable in full [F2][F5][NS-4].

The driver's no-show route cannot rescue the fee either. NS-1 requires the driver to have pressed "I'm Here" (or platform auto-arrival) with GPS inside the pickup radius, then to wait continuously beyond 3 minutes [F3][F4][NS-1]. No arrival of any kind is recorded: driver_arrived_at is null and driver_pressed_here_at is null [F3][F4][NS-1]. The closest GPS approach was 2189 m at the moment of cancellation, i.e. never within the 200 m arrival radius [F1][NS-1]. Both NS-1 (i) and (ii) fail, so under NS-2 the $6.61 is refunded in full to the rider [F1][NS-1][NS-2].

The driver's statements do not change this: his 14:06 chat "5 min more, traffic is slow" and his later "I was on my way when the rider cancelled" are consistent with being en route only, and system records (GPS) override statements where they conflict [F8][F10][F1][NS-1]. Traffic and weather records are immaterial, since no exemption is being claimed and none is needed [F11][F12][F13][NS-4].

Amount: the disputed item is the cancellation fee $6.61 recorded in the fare fact, refunded in full under NS-4/NS-2 [F5][NS-4][NS-2]; no distance fare computation applies because RydeX is a fixed-quote service and the whole item is returned [F5][F6][NS-0]. No flag_account: the NS-2 flag is triggered only where an "I'm Here" tap was made while GPS showed the driver away from pickup, and no tap was ever recorded here [F4][NS-2].

rejected_claims.reason: The claim concedes the timing but argues the fee outcome; on the facts it actually supports the refund: F2 shows 175 s after acceptance, inside NS-4's 3:00 no-charge window, and F5 records the $6.61 [F2][F5][NS-4].
Correct as far as it goes (F3, F4 show no arrival record), but it cannot support retaining the fee; NS-1 is not established and NS-2 requires full refund [F3][F4][NS-1][NS-2].
The claim itself concedes NS-1 (ii) fails on F1 and that the fee is refundable under NS-2; the driver's admission supports refund_full rather than any reduction [F1][NS-1][NS-2].

No adverse account action follows from profile facts, but the claim's request to keep the fee fails: the fee falls on F1/F2/F3/F4 under NS-1 and NS-2, and F15 (profile) cannot decide the case [F15][NS-1][NS-2].
Correct that NS-3's cancellation-rate mechanism is Ryde's own and not a remedy here, but it does not save the fee; NS-4/NS-2 still require the refund [F2][F5][NS-4][NS-2].
The traffic point (F11 band 4, F12 no incidents, F13 fair) is accepted but immaterial: no exemption is claimed and the fee already fails NS-1 (i) and (ii) on F1/F3/F4 [F11][F12][F13][F1][NS-1].
The completeness point is accepted (F9), but completeness of the chat does not create a chargeable fee; the outcome follows F2 under NS-4 [F9][F2][NS-4].
Accepted as far as it goes (F8, F10 are statements contradicted by F1), which leaves nothing in the driver's favour and confirms the full refund under NS-2 [F8][F10][F1][NS-2].
